tests: decompengine.repair.RepairStagingAuthorityReceiptTest.deletion patch-count refusal retains the first deletion without charging the refused one
decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair request-byte budget refuses before dispatch and preserves the accepted head
command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild --tests 'decompengine.repair.RepairStagingAuthorityReceiptTest.deletion patch-count refusal retains the first deletion without charging the refused one' --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active repair request-byte budget refuses before dispatch and preserves the accepted head'

scope.activeRequestBudget: The repair loop rejects an over-budget request with a bounded diagnostic before agent dispatch; the accepted source/head remain unchanged, no candidate node or pending attempt is created, and the run is recorded RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.
scope.deletionPatchCount: The lower-level BoundedRepairOutput sink retains the first authorized deletion and refuses a second distinct deletion under maximumPatchFiles=1 without recording that second change.
limitations: The deletion test is lower-level captured-output coverage, not public ACP repair; active ACP repair authorizes only READ_FILE and WRITE_FILE and exposes no delete callback.
Local tests only; no hosted exact-head qualification, live provider, successful production repair validation under #236, or complete #734/#63 acceptance.
